newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves discount rate at one pct after meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves discount rate at one pct after meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after the regular weekly meeting of its three-man policy-setting board, a spokesman for the central bank said.
The discount rate was last changed when it was lowered to one percent from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996.

Despite weakness in the Swiss economy, most market observers had expected no cut in the discount. SNB officials have also said they would wait with any tightening until the economy shows clear signs of a recovery.
At one percent, the discount rate matches the historic low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
